## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

Closes #<issue-number>

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / internal change
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Checklist

- [ ] `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` pass
- [ ] `go test -race ./...` passes
- [ ] `golangci-lint run ./...` passes (or N/A)
- [ ] Regenerated code and golden files are committed, if generation was
      affected (`go generate ./internal/...`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Documentation updated (`README.md`, `docs/`, or godoc) if behavior
      changed
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits

## Notes for reviewers

Anything reviewers should focus on, trade-offs made, or follow-ups deferred.
